```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

#Question 1

```{r}
bdays = sample(1:365, 25, replace = TRUE)

length(unique(bdays)) < 25
```

```{r}
bday = function(n) {
  if (!is.numeric(n)) {
    stop("n must be numerical")
  } else if (n<2) {
    stop("group has at least 2 ppl")
  }
  
  bdays = sample (1:365, n, replace = TRUE)
  
  any(duplicated(bdays))
}

bday(10)
bday(50)
```

```{r}
bday_function_df =
  expand.grid(
    group_size = 2:50,
    iter = 1:10000
  ) |>
  mutate(
    shared = map_lgl(group_size, bday)
  )

prob_df =
  bday_function_df |>
  group_by(group_size) |>
  summarise(prob_shared = mean(shared))
```


```{r}
prob_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = group_size, y = prob_shared)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Probability of shared birthday",
    x = "Group size",
    y = "Probability of shared birthday"
  )
```
The probability of a shared birthday rises steadily as group size increases. It reaches 50% probability at around a group size of 23 and increases to 96% probability at a group size of 48 and plateaus afterwards.
